g.text: Scenario Player and V2X ECU — call flow (M1: receive-only)
A — Bring-up: control plane, in-node — NO wire traffic, NO authentication
No handshake, no session, no credentials on this wire.
Connectionless broadcast semantics — production Rx is
ITS security (TS 103 097 signing / PKI) ships in the
modem and is out of scope for the whole project.
B — Broadcast Rx: bench streams C's perception (R11 -> R9) — COMMITTED PATH
build CPM — header + management + OVC + PerceivedObject(C)
This is the whole M1 V2X data path: inform the ADA ECU
of an obstruction outside ego's line of sight.
C — Broadcast Tx (R10) — NOT IN M1, moved to the future plan
Deferred by user decision 2026-07-30. The M1 V2X ECU is
receive-only, so this wire is unidirectional.
No ADA -> V2X path, no CPM encoder on the ECU, no Tx port.
R7 still declares send(); nothing calls it — the seam is
what keeps R10 a later implementation, not a redesign.
D — Fault injection: R8 in-node + bench impairment feeding the R9 corpus
log defined recovery — node never crashes
reject + increment counter, no forward to ADA
age out tracks; flush JSONL evidence log (R18)
